title: BaselineEnvelope
description: Shared envelope contract for every committed Mandrel baseline (lint, coverage, crap, maintainability, mutation, lighthouse, bundle-size). Each per-kind schema extends this envelope via allOf to constrain the row shape. The committed file carries no run timestamp and no rollup: both were rewritten on every refresh, so two branches refreshing disjoint rows always conflicted textually — and GitHub (PR mergeability, update-branch, the merge queue) never runs the custom merge driver. Readers derive the rollup from rows[]; freshness is the file's git history. The envelope itself is intentionally agnostic about row contents so the kernel can evolve without churning the shared contract.

$schema.description: Pointer back to the per-kind schema for editor tooling and AJV resolution.

kernelVersion.description: Semver version of the in-repo kernel that produced this baseline. Bumped when the scoring formula, scan shape, or rollup math changes. Consumers compare against the running kernel and emit drift signals when they mismatch.

scoringSemantics.description: Optional per-kind stamp identifying the SCORING SEMANTICS that produced these rows — the dimension kernelVersion cannot express, because a kind's own scoring can change while the upstream package it stamps does not. A baseline whose stamp differs from the running scorer's is incomparable and the gate fails closed with re-baseline guidance rather than comparing across the boundary.

tsTranspilerVersion.description: Optional per-kind stamp identifying the TypeScript transpiler that produced the sourcemap these rows' line coordinates were resolved through (Story #4866). Only meaningful for kinds whose rows carry a line coordinate derived from transpiled sources; a transpiler change can move every such coordinate, and for kinds that key rows on a line that coordinate is half the row identity.

provenanceStamped.description: Legacy per-kind stamp, no longer written: the CRAP writer once used it to assert that each row's coordinate provenance was recorded. It stays accepted so a baseline written before the grouped CRAP layout parses and reaches the kind's scoring-semantics compat axis, which fails it closed with the re-seed command, instead of dying on a raw schema error.

rows.description: Per-row metrics. Order is kind-specific (e.g. CRAP sorts by path then method key); per-kind schemas tighten the item shape. Exactly one of rows and files is present.

files.description: Grouped on-disk row layout for kinds whose codec writes one (CRAP): each canonical path once, mapped to its per-row values. Exactly one of rows and files is present; readers decode it back to rows through the kind's layout codec.
